summary: A prompt given to Claude Opus asking it to create a video designed to go viral, leading to a coded physics simulation and synthesizer synchronized with Für Elise.

post.originalText:
I gave Claude Opus 5.5 one prompt: "make a video that could go viral."

It wrote a physics sim, built a synth that plays Für Elise one bounce at a time, and rendered all 1,904 frames itself.

Which ring did you think would trap it? 🔊 https://t.co/AjDDCc9NWz
